provenance: OC-023: first graded-pack benchmark over three physically-distinct measured vendor datasets. Identical requirement, geometry, sampling, limits and cost blocks as OC-022 (racetrack, 0.3 m straight half-length, 0.2 m bend radius, 0.9 T bore target, util limit 0.8, 0.85-fraction turn index for the interior sampling lobe). The candidate grid is a subset of OC-022's (turns 200/240/300 x tapes 2/3 — the region where OC-022's optimum and near-misses live) so the 9-assignment product stays under the 64-candidate work limit. Regions split turns_along_normal at the radial midpoint as in OC-022, but each region now chooses among all three embedded measured datasets: base is robinson-superpower-ap-v3 (SuperPower AP 12 mm tape, 1 mm bridge, csv_sha256 889cc2cf8b91b822cbc6cceb7388e5d8afcb8a8911bb20ab175e50c7e6dc0354, monotonicity_tolerance 0.001, low_field_clamp_t 1.001); hts-shanghai is robinson-shanghai-hflt-v3 (Shanghai SC HFLT 4 mm tape, 0.5 mm bridge, csv_sha256 d53fbab65426c2d2f00ddd19ebe0470b1f73fb8a3e64b23b8f7ae871ec29c4a3, monotonicity_tolerance 0.025 justified by its 7-8 T instrument-edge audit, low_field_clamp_t 1.001); hts-theva is robinson-theva-ap-v2 (THEVA Pro-Line AP 6 mm tape, 0.5 mm bridge, csv_sha256 0e3cc4af5031c22cae4e7a10a5852c7302555d92db84a9220f6c7ed59d411474, monotonicity_tolerance 0.001 — its dataset audit is clean: 0 increases across all 1530 measured field-sweep pairs — low_field_clamp_t 1.001). All three were measured on the same Robinson 1 kA instrument under the same criterion and conventions. At 25 K the measured worst-angle ordering is strictly THEVA > Shanghai > AP, growing with field (TH/AP = 1.06x at 1 T to 1.57x at 8 T), so the nine assignments give the optimizer a real price-performance frontier, including rejecting the premium tape where its capacity is unneeded. Prices are invented placeholders (base 30 USD/m, hts-shanghai 34 USD/m as in OC-022, hts-theva 38 USD/m — a ~27% premium over base for the strongest measured tape), not vendor quotes. Per-width measured capacity is compared at the case-level 12 mm tape width; the 4 mm and 6 mm product-width differences are a stated limitation, not modeled.
